insight: Both John 1:1 and Genesis 1:1 begin with the phrase 'In the beginning,' linking the eternal nature of the Word with the absolute origin of creation. While Genesis establishes God as the sovereign Creator who brings the heavens and earth into existence, John reveals that the Word, who is fully God and distinct in person, existed eternally before creation began. This connection underscores the deity and pre-existence of Christ as the divine agent present with God at creation.
